newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary radio noon headlines - Nov 20
newsitem.headline: Hungary radio noon headlines - Nov 20

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Hungary's parliament will start new all-party negotiations on the basic principles of a new constitution.
- The parliament's special committee dealing with oil sales and Russia's debt towards Hungary, has asked its chairman to resign.
- The energy workers' union proposed a compensation for the enrgy price increases from 50 percent of VAT on energy.
- Encouraging food export is one of the topics of the Foodapest '96 expo opened today.
- National rail transport company MAV will get a 300 million Ecu foreign loan, but with conditions.
- A Budapest court has started the trial of brokerage Lupis, that went bust leaving huge debts.
